description: With Open Team Sheets declined, Team Preview shows the opponent's species, level, gender and shiny flag; the sheet is sent only after `>show-openteamsheets`. The champions `teampreview` handler masks Xerneas, Zacian and Zamazenta formes but, unlike the base handler, does not strip `, shiny`: cosmetic, but a potential fingerprint. Whether the training observation strips it is open (owner: ADR-008 observation contract). The item field of every Team Preview `poke` message is empty at the pin, although `sim/SIM-PROTOCOL.md` documents an `item` marker; a pin that sends it would reveal item presence. CTS is a project choice (ADR-003), not the VGC tournament rule (see `open-team-sheets`); what in-game Ranked preview shows is unverified (format matrix U7). Tested in-process by `cts.test.ts` (#676); the server-path decline is #709.
